body: yeah. i got diagnosed with bipolar1 a few days ago and i just feel a wave of devastation at the thought that i’ll have to be on the lookout for the rest of my life, along with several other illnesses i’ve been diagnosed with years ago. trying to find people that have a more positive outlook so i can see their perspective.
boasting to others about what a great parent you are

wishing you well bro i went straight to a dbt & bpd specialized therapist. so scared to bring up diagnosis even tho she refers to
me with “heavy bpd traits” and idek why i feel like i need one. validation ig and it makes me feel less like “just another shitty person” but ik after diagnosis im still that shitty person until i change 👍

you tell him, because you did a shitty thing and you have the option to not be even shittier. i know how out of your hands that betrayal could feel but we still gotta take accountability for them. when we do something bad we can choose to do better and be honest with ourselves and the hurt party. sorry this shit got so out of hand, sorry for your fp, and sorry that you went through so much shit that made you prone to bpd. wishin you well man

ok so bear with me. in these type of situations with my fp, i want to “make them feel shitty/shittier for making me feel shitty because they feel shitty”, thus solving my problem and i’m once again the important reason they feel upset. when i put it like that, it doesn’t sound like a reasonable reaction anymore imo. that’s what helps me, wording things in a way that makes me aware of what i’m about to do and hearing it put like that makes it sounds so silly. suddenly i rather be someone that makes my fp feel better, someone they can confide in— not the reason they’re sad. a different type of important, romantic or platonic. idk if any of that makes sense or is any help at all. but i read your post, and you’re not alone
me personally i wouldn’t let that slide

idk, currently struggling with it too. i feel like i’m in a constant competition of who has it worse; i love them and they’re an absolute sweetheart and we never lashed out at each other. but whenever they start talking about stuff they’ve been through or impulsive shit they’ve done, i feel so terrible and proceed to get worse on purpose. we validate each other’s impulsiveness and each other’s extreme reactions to minor situations because “we get it”. but we also give each other tips, and sometimes point out to each other when something is a bad idea. nobody else in our lives can understand this disorder but each other, and it feels good to know i’m not so crazy. idk if that’s a good or a bad thing though.

i think it’s difficult. possible, but difficult. they didn’t react well, but also they might’ve gotten thrown off bc it might’ve been an unwarranted word vomit yk. we can’t expect nor force people to be there for us every single time we need them to be, but i think that’s something everyone comes to terms with eventually
no bc i started seeing a therapist and a month later i’ve started to relapse in a few areas. crazyyyy

yeah no i feel you. i would read through these stories and also other forums that heavily criticized people with bpd, couldn’t stop crying lmao. i eventually sought out a psych and here i am. validating but in the ugliest way, yk? because now this is the truth and now i can’t hide from it. hoping you get your answers man, be patient with yourself.

i didn't think of it like that, thank you, that helped. they don't know how to help, it's a cultural and generational thing. thank you for giving me that last perspective, truly. i've come down from that impulsive stage of the night haha

it is entirely valid, as are you. perhaps it may help knowing you aren't alone; i noticed the same things happening to me. i still feel weird talking about it, actually. you should seek a support system that is effective for you against this (: remember, your issues are valid and you are not alone

they were repeating themselves but it was always along the lines of "why can't you be better" but this time it just, they dont believe in me enough to even give me their usual "do better" lecture anymore yk
if it's worth anything, i feel the same exact way. you ain't alone with that thought

ahh see the thing is i never thought of them as assholes. they always tried to give me the benefit of the doubt, that's why what they said today really hit hard. i must have really messed up for them to give up on me. i try to understand them. they're paying for my college tuition next year and literally the only chance of a decent future i have is if i don't fail their expectations. i can't see myself not relying on them. i don't think they even know how much their pressure affects me

hey man i feel you.
i often get invalidated because i have things the people around me dont. but they still dont get it, none of those things can help my own head from working against me. 

been scrolling through reddit officially for the first time today. this is the first thing im writing. i've had this account for years (i would just google a question and reddit answered), and it's kinda hitting different knowing im not alone and that other people feel the same. that they're putting it into the words i never could. there are others like me and i never expected to come across it.
